claude.performance_metric: acquired by Shire ~12 months after separation; deregistered via Form 15-12B; no separate 3-5yr outcome record
claude.rationale: The slice documents that Baxalta operated as an independent registrant for only ~one year (single FY2015 10-K) before being acquired by Shire and deregistering its common stock in June 2016, so the fixed 3-5-year outcome window contains no audited public financial statements or located separate disclosure of the acquired business's trajectory. There is therefore no realized-outcome evidence of disruption at the product/process interface (p4) or the process/organization interface (p5); the slice explicitly states the outcome is coded uncertain per the no-record rule rather than fabricated. Because the outcome record is truncated and no post-window trajectory was established, all pathway/channel fields are uncertain.
